fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-05-19, the complainant was stopped by a group near Roja Park Main Street, and a wristwatch along with cash of around Rs. 3,000 were taken under threat. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-05-19 at approximately 20:30. Contact details given by the complainant, Deviga Devi, include the number 9000000460. The complaint refers to Sanjay Mani, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000120. No independent witness was identified at the time of registration. The complaint mentions Gunasekar Anand, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000050, in connection with the events. A motorcycle bearing the number TN-38-YY-1022 was seen leaving the area. The complainant mentioned a vehicle observation and mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly intercepted and threatened before valuables were taken.
fields.Keywords: robbery, threat, associate, phone records, main street, vehicle observation, evening, mobile number
